## [1.0.0] - 2024-XX-XX

### Added
- Initial release of n8n-nodes-justcall
- JustCall node for interacting with JustCall Calls API
- Support for making calls, managing contacts, sending SMS, and managing phone numbers
- AI Voice Agent integration
- Webhook trigger support for JustCall events
- API credentials configuration
